item.title: Newscast – Friday, Feb. 20, 2026
item.description: In this newscast: Juneau choreographer Hali Duran explores the six stages of a queen bumblebee's life cycle in Acoustic Turbulence -- a new production of Orpheus Project, showing this weekend; A large gravel lot in the hear of downtown Juneau's tourism corridor has sat empty for years. But that might soon change; In a recent budget meeting, the Juneau School Board discussed adding rather than cutting positions next school year; Alaska saw its eighth hottest year on record last year.
